Name: Nehushta, Mother of Jehoiachin
Summary: Nehushta, daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem, was the mother of Jehoiachin, and was carried to Babylon with him.
KeyStory: Nehushta, mother of Jehoiachin, carried to Babylon.
RelatedPeople: Jehoiachin, King of Judah; Elnathan, Father of Nehushta
LifeLesson: A queen mother went into exile with the son she had raised to the throne.
